newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil surges at close on export talk.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil surges at close on export talk.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Talk of a higher January export data pushed up palm oil prices at the close. There was a lot of switching activity from March/April and March/May. Talk that Indonesia was buying here also aided sentiment. More buying was seen when April futures trade around 1,283 and 1,284.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - More demand was seen among Feb CPOs and RBD palm olein. Some refiners' covering was also noted.
Traders said the market is likely to firm in near-term on expectation of more fresh tenders.

"Technically, there was a lot of buying when April futures was trading at around 1,283 and 1,284 ringgit," another trader said. He added: "The market held relatively steady this morning and a lot of switching was seen again in futures market from March to April and March to May."
At the close, the April futures contract was 11 ringgit higher at 1,285 ringgit ($516.89) a tonne after trading in 12-ringgit range.
Mar (south) saw offers at 1,325 with bids at 1,320, and Mar (central) at 1,325 against 1,312.50.
Among refined products, Feb RBD palm oil was offered at $565 a tonne FOB Malaysia, Mar at $560 and Apr/May/Jun at $547.50.
Feb RBD palm olein saw offers at $595, Mar at $587.50 and Apr/May/Jun at $577.50. Mar was traded at $587.50 and Apr/May/Jun at $577.50.
Feb/Mar RBD palm stearin was offered at $452.50 and Feb/Mar palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $305. -- Tan Lee Lee - (603-230-7510) ($1 =2.4860 ringgit)
